description: Overwrites the given app settings (up to 50 keys); the rest keep their values. Keep each value's type: CometChat doesn't check it. Returns the keys sent, not a read-back.

approval_code.description: The code the user got after approving this exact change in their browser. Only ever from the user; never make one up or reuse one for different arguments.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has explicitly agreed to this change. On a local connection that is enough; on the hosted server this change needs approval_code from the user's browser instead, and confirm is ignored.

settings.description: Setting key → new value (string, number or boolean)

name: cometchat_update_app_settings
title: Update app settings
